title: Tower Light Out
summary: An emergency broadcaster reads the power-grid report, and every district she names goes dark exactly as she says it.

beats.text: This is the Port Ellis broadcast. Tonight, one switch keeps the city lights alive.
It sits in the harbour substation. I am the engineer who can reach it.
I am walking there now. Forty infected shuffle along the road.
They follow light, so I switch the lamps off behind me.
The substation door is open. It was locked this morning.
The panel is warm. The fuse is already replaced.
My phone buzzes. A message, from the control room: Do not touch the switch.
The control room has been silent six days.
Listeners, I have not touched it. Who wrote that?
My radio answers, in a child's voice: Keep the lights off, lady. I fixed it.
beats.speaker: girl

beats.text: On a dark hilltop, a small hand waved a torch. The lights stay off tonight.
